items.title: Langchain Community SSRF Bypass Vulnerability Enables Access to Internal Services
items.description: A Server‑Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability has been identified in the langchain/community package, affecting versions up to 1.1.13. The flaw, tracked as CVE‑2026‑26019, has a moderate severity rating, with a CVSS 3.1 score, due on its potential to expose sensitive cloud metadata and internal infrastructure. items.title: Apple Tests End-to-End Encrypted RCS Messaging in iOS 26.4 Developer Beta
items.description: Apple on Monday released a new developer beta of iOS and iPadOS with support for end-to-end encryption (E2EE) in Rich Communications Services (RCS) messages. The feature is currently available for testing in iOS and iPadOS 26.4 Beta, and is expected to be shipped to customers in a future update for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and watchOS. items.title: 25 Vulnerabilities in Cloud Password Managers Allow Unauthorized Access and Modifications
items.description: Researchers from ETH Zurich have uncovered 25 serious vulnerabilities in three leading cloud-based password managers: Bitwarden, LastPass, and Dashlane. These flaws enable a malicious server to bypass zero-knowledge encryption claims, allowing unauthorized access, modification, and recovery of users’ stored passwords and vault data.
